scope: Site-only review on November 12, 2026 UTC, separate from the existing corpus census pins. Browser evidence covers the catalogue and all 14 record pages at 1280 and 390 pixels, identifier/name searches, category filtering, keyboard reset, reload and explicit query URLs, no-JavaScript access and blocked data requests. All 36 publicly packaged manifest assets matched their hashes; the pinned Pages uploader excludes two recorded internal build markers. Deployment 7729964604 remained successful at the same revision before and after the browser pass, with served Last-Modified later than deployment creation. Feature verdicts are reviewed against the existing 24-feature catalogue; missing features are recorded without inferring scientific deficiencies.

search.note: The labelled catalogue search finds both CofactorMech:biotin and biotin, each showing one of 14 records with a working record link. Unmatched and literal-markup queries show zero matches.

facets.note: The Category selector filters the complete listing; Coenzyme shows six records. Keyboard activation of Reset filters restores all 14 and returns focus to the search field.

result_counts.note: Showing N of 14 records responds to search, category filtering and reset; the empty state retains the total and explains how to recover.

sorting.note: The listing uses a fixed name order and exposes no sort selector or sortable column headings.

shareable_state.note: An explicitly supplied ?q=biotin URL restores the search, but changing the search or category in the interface does not update the URL; reloading the ordinary search loses its state.

full_catalogue.note: All 14 records counted by the manifest have catalogue links and served record pages. The complete 14-record table remains visible with JavaScript disabled.

record_pages.note: Every catalogue record has a stable records/<slug>/index.html page; all 14 pages rendered populated identity, relationship, gap and provenance sections.

term_links.note: Chemical evidence links its ChEBI source, but the primary chemical CURIE and related target CURIEs are plain text. Biotin's related CHEBI:57586 has neither a resolver link nor a readable chemical label in its target field.

evidence.note: All record pages render their recorded evidence URLs as Source reference links beside the claim and source locator. Biotin links its chemical identity and each scoped relationship's supporting source.

review_status.note: PROVISIONAL and VERIFIED badges describe individual relationships. Record pages do not state a whole-record curation or review status.

curation_history.note: Each record's Curation provenance table shows its recorded timestamp, action, curator and change summary, with a link to the history source.

source_link.note: Each record links its own YAML on GitHub at the displayed repository revision and offers the same source YAML as a site download; the public source-file hashes match the manifest.

domain_view.note: The published catalogue and record pages provide text and tables; no chemical structure, embedding map or relationship diagram is offered.

cross_mech_links.note: Scoped relationships link specific source records in sibling repositories at recorded revisions. Biotin links MediaIngredientMech, ProteinTraitsMech and PathwayMech records while retaining provisional and conjugate-form distinctions.

corpus_stats.note: The generated landing page shows 14 records and category counts of six coenzymes, five metal ions and three prosthetic groups, matching its corpus manifest.

category_browse.note: Category counts appear as static tiles and the catalogue has a working category filter, but no linked category pages or category index routes are published.

suite_nav.note: The visible All Mech projects navigation link leads to the maintained X-Mech Suite directory from the catalogue and every record page.

downloads.note: Every record offers its YAML and the footer links a corpus manifest, but the site does not link a bulk export containing all record content.

schema_docs.note: The footer links the raw LinkML YAML schema. No rendered schema documentation or class/slot browsing page is published in this site artifact.

license.note: Catalogue and record footers state CC-BY-4.0 for curated records and CC0 for original code and schemas, link the licence notice, and retain upstream attribution. These agree with the repository LICENSE.

build_provenance.note: Every page states the repository revision and corpus/schema SHA-256 stamps; the linked corpus manifest records the same deployed revision and per-file hashes.

theme_toggle.note: No theme toggle is offered. Emulating a dark operating-system preference leaves the same light page background.

responsive.note: The catalogue and all 14 record pages have no document overflow at 390 pixels. Wide catalogue and history tables stay inside labelled, keyboard-focusable horizontal scroll regions.

load_failure.note: The catalogue and record content are server-rendered HTML. No fetch or XHR data requests occurred across the 15 pages; blocking those request types left search functional, and all records remain accessible without JavaScript.
